verses.text: David sang the words of this song to the LORD on the day the LORD rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul.
He said: "The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and the one who rescues me.
God is my rock, and I run to him for safety. He is my shield and my strong saviour, my high tower and my safe place. My Saviour, you save me from violent people.
I call to the LORD, who deserves all praise, and I am saved from my enemies.
The waves of death surrounded me. Floods of evil swept over me and made me afraid.
The ropes of the grave were wrapped around me. The traps of death were set in front of me.
In my trouble I called to the LORD. Yes, I cried to my God. From his temple he heard my voice. My cry reached his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the heavens rocked and shook, because he was angry.
Smoke came out of his nose, and burning fire came out of his mouth. Burning coals blazed out from him.
He opened the heavens and came down. Dark clouds were under his feet.
He rode on a winged creature and flew. He soared on the wings of the wind.
He wrapped himself in darkness like a tent, with dark rain clouds and thick clouds of the sky.
From the brightness around him, burning coals of fire blazed out.
The LORD thundered from heaven. The voice of the Most High was heard.
He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies. He sent lightning and threw them into confusion.
Then the bottom of the sea could be seen, and the foundations of the world were uncovered, when the LORD spoke sharply, at the blast of breath from his nose.
He reached down from above and took hold of me. He pulled me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from those who hated me, because they were too strong for me.
They attacked me on the day I was in trouble, but the LORD held me up.
He brought me out into a wide, open place. He rescued me because he was pleased with me.
The LORD rewarded me because I did what was right. He gave back to me because my hands were clean.
For I have followed the ways of the LORD. I have not done evil by turning away from my God.
I have kept all his laws in front of me. I have not turned away from his rules.
I was without fault before him, and I kept myself from sin.
So the LORD has rewarded me for doing what is right, because he has seen that my hands are clean.
To people who are faithful, you show that you are faithful. To people who are without fault, you show that you are without fault.
To people who are pure, you show that you are pure. But to people who are crooked, you show that you are clever.
You save humble people, but your eyes watch proud people so that you can bring them down.
LORD, you are my lamp. The LORD lights up my darkness.
With your help I can charge against an army. With my God I can climb over a wall.
God's way is perfect. The LORD's word has been tested and is true. He is a shield for everyone who runs to him for safety.
For who is God except the LORD? And who is a rock except our God?
God is my strong fortress, and he makes my way perfect.
He makes my feet as sure as the feet of a deer, and he helps me stand safely on the high places.
He trains my hands for battle, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have given me your shield that saves me. Your gentle help has made me great.
You made a wide path for my feet, so that my ankles did not slip.
I chased my enemies and destroyed them. I did not turn back until they were wiped out.
I wiped them out and struck them down, so that they could not get up. They fell under my feet.
You gave me strength for the battle. You made my attackers bow down under me.
You made my enemies turn their backs and run, and I destroyed those who hated me.
They looked for help, but no one saved them. They even called to the LORD, but he did not answer them.
I crushed them as fine as the dust of the earth. I stamped on them and trampled them like mud in the streets.
You rescued me when my own people fought against me. You kept me as the leader of nations. People I did not know now serve me.
Foreigners bow down to me. As soon as they hear about me, they obey me.
Foreigners lose their courage, and they come trembling out of their hiding places.
The LORD lives! Praise be to my rock! May God, the rock who saves me, be honoured!
He is the God who pays back my enemies for me, and he puts nations under my control.
He sets me free from my enemies. You lift me up above those who attack me. You rescue me from violent people.
So I will thank you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to your name.
He gives great victories to his king. He shows his faithful love to his chosen king, to David and his descendants forever."
